message.content: Driving from San Francisco to Los Angeles typically covers about 380–400 miles (≈610–640 km) via I‑5 S or US‑101 S. Under normal conditions—no major detours or heavy traffic—a straight‑through drive takes roughly **6 to 7 hours**. In peak commute periods or during holiday rushes, you might see 8–9 hours or more, especially if you’re heading into the Los Angeles metro area where congestion can add significant delays.
